types.name: Fenrir::ChangeError
types.doc: What a script asked for that the change buffer refused at once: the result of every native that records a structural change. C# throws on anything but None, with a message that says which change was attempted, so one value serves a component and a resource alike. Described for the C# binding, so the values are the contract's.

values.name: None
values.doc: The change was recorded, to play back when the system returns.

values.name: EntityNotAlive
values.doc: The entity is not alive in the active scene.

values.name: Unknown
values.doc: No component, event or resource has the id.

values.name: ReadOnly
values.doc: Scripts may only read the component or resource, so they cannot add, remove, insert or remove it.

values.name: Required
values.doc: The engine needs every entity to have the component (Transform, Name, Relationship), so it cannot be removed.

values.name: NotActive
values.doc: Scripting is not running, so there is no scene to change.

types.name: Fenrir::RegistryError
types.doc: Why a lookup of a component, event or resource by name gave no id. A lookup native returns the id when it found one, otherwise one of these; the binding's generated enum lets C# name the reason it throws for. Described for the C# binding (api/FenrirScripting.api.toml), so the values below are the contract's.

values.name: NotRegistered
values.doc: Nothing is registered under the name.

values.name: WrongType
values.doc: The name is registered for a different C# type than the one asking, so the layout check would be skipped.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptingConfig
types.doc: Where scripting finds .NET and the project's script assembly. A settings type (ADR-0084): a project file fills it as `Fenrir::ScriptingConfig` before Install, every field but `extensions`.

fields.name: scriptAssembly
fields.doc: The project's one script assembly (`Fenrir::ScriptingConfig.scriptAssembly` in the project's `<name>.project.json5`). Empty means the project has no scripts: Install then does nothing and never starts .NET.

fields.name: bridgeDirectory
fields.doc: The directory holding Iris.Bridge.dll, its .runtimeconfig.json, the scripting contract Fenrir.Scripting.dll and the math contract Fenrir.Math.dll (the build's fenrir_deploy_scripting puts them next to the executable). Empty means the executable's own directory.

fields.name: dotnetRoot
fields.doc: An absolute .NET installation root, or empty for the default search.

fields.name: hotReload
fields.doc: Whether to watch `scriptAssembly` and reload it, between frames, when a build replaces it. Either way the assembly is loaded from a private copy, so a build can always overwrite the original.

fields.name: reloadDirectory
fields.doc: Where the per-generation copies of the script assembly go. Empty means a directory of its own under the system temporary directory. Each loaded generation has a subdirectory, deleted once that generation is unloaded.

fields.name: reloadInterval
fields.doc: How often the watcher looks at the file, in milliseconds. Zero looks every frame.

fields.name: reloadDebounce
fields.doc: How long the file must stay unchanged, and openable, before it counts as a finished build, in milliseconds.

fields.name: unloadTimeout
fields.doc: How long a reload waits for the old generation to unload, in milliseconds. A generation that has not unloaded by then is kept track of (see Scripting::PendingUnloadCount) and the reload goes on.
